stories.title: Define triage display schema and frontend contract
stories.description: Define TypeScript interfaces and API response contract for provider triage results including pass/fail status, specialty match explanation, and ordered reasoning blocks (specialty first, then quality). Ensure alignment with backend EVAL-P-TRIAGE output.
stories.evidence: GAP: No provider triage UI or contract exists; schema must be defined to render triage reasoning.

stories.title: Implement triage reasoning prioritization logic (frontend)
stories.description: Implement frontend logic to order and render triage explanations with specialty match shown before any quality scores, and clear pass/fail indicators. Handle edge cases (missing specialty, partial matches, fail states).
stories.evidence: GAP: No provider triage UI; ordering logic required to meet requirement 'specialty match before quality scores'.

stories.title: Build triage display UI components
stories.description: Create reusable React components to display provider triage results including pass/fail badge, specialty match explanation, and expandable reasoning sections. Integrate into existing chat/provider result view.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx (existing rendering patterns); GAP: no dedicated triage UI components.

stories.title: Frontend integration and API binding for triage display
stories.description: Connect UI components to backend triage API response, map fields to display schema, and ensure graceful handling of loading, errors, and empty states within the chat flow.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx (API interaction patterns); GAP: no triage-specific binding exists.

stories.title: Triage display tests (unit + UI states)
stories.description: Create unit tests for ordering logic and component rendering plus UI state tests (pass, fail, partial, missing data). Validate specialty-first rule and correct explanation visibility.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ (testing patterns exist); GAP: no frontend triage tests currently defined.
